embeddingContract: one active ZotQuery Search model shared by PDF chunks and Note segments; verified equivalent endpoints retain the indexed cache identity
researchWorkbench: research desk; grouped retrieval and manual review; synchronized vision permission; stable fixed-column stop button; distinct history action layout at wide and narrow widths; paginated evidence and immutable answer revisions
researchHistory: local SQLite answer_runs; request checkpoints and numeric diagnostics; legacy sessions discoverable; cold resume from facts and remaining actions; no persisted reasoning transcripts or credentials
evidenceDurability: successful PDF context reads saved as snapshots; reassessments retain prior assessment revisions; failed reads do not count as reading; Survey note promotion defaults to 50-work pages with bounded model navigation receipts while complete results remain in the persisted ledger
toolbarInitialization: final workbench button registered before core startup; generated core delegates directly; initially disabled until ready
answerViewer: rendered Markdown by default; editable source toggle; original Markdown export
markdownParser: marked 17.0.5 lexer; allowlisted DOM construction; no raw HTML execution or automatic remote images
modelConfigurationUI: grouped model-answer, retrieval-indexing, MCP and maintenance; centered native preference buttons; optional Markdown answer template; note parsing advanced; output-profile controls removed; shared immediate vision switch in preferences and research desk; budget controls and saved values preserved
oneClickResearch: model query planning precedes automatic session creation in one action; explicit session binding; no full-library rebuild
llmSecrets: Zotero login manager; never ordinary preferences
llmCredentialWrites: await addLoginAsync for new keys; modifyLogin in place for replacements; UI awaits persistence
llmGatePolicy: persisted gate controls verified vs clearly labeled limited model answer; audit never replaces answer
llmAnswerFlow: configured research budget plus up to six tool-enabled writing turns, then a separate tool-disabled final synthesis when still unfinished; last tool response and reasoning retained; incomplete evidence yields explicitly limited model output, not an audit substitution
llmContinuation: phase-aware writer/final resume in memory and SQLite; cold writer re-reads original sources without restarting planning; learned budget remains configuration-bound; older 3.1.13 writer checkpoints recognized without rewriting old rows
llmDeepSeekProtocol: explicit thinking toggle and effort mapping; reasoning_content roundtripped on assistant messages; token-limit responses rejected as incomplete
llmConnectionTest: two-turn synthetic tool receipt; no library access; does not establish research quality
llmMarkdownTemplate: optional user-imported .md file; template-free generation supported; no bundled Markdown output template; untrusted format-only context
llmOutputBudget: manual preserved; auto published output limit, learned route limit or OpenAI-compatible provider default; at most two explicit provider-limit corrections and two truncation increases per run; request-local context allowance is never cached as route output limit; no fixed local token ceiling
llmContextRecovery: provider-measured high input may trigger at most two proactive protocol-complete restarts; one further provider-confirmed capacity recovery; no character-count hard rejection; original evidence retained in database and nonempty source re-read required
llmRequestDiagnostics: pre/post request and post-tool checkpoints; requested/effective budget, measured tokens, status, duration, timeout, research/writing/final phase, completed writing rounds, tool-call count and numeric message sizes; no raw HTTP bodies or reasoning content persisted
nativeDatabaseRows: explicit SQL-column projection; never spread mozStorage proxy rows
visualEvidence: opt-in PDF page/normalized-region images using Zotero bundled PDF.js; API image parts and MCP image blocks; persisted page/crop/file fingerprint/image hash; model visual observations separate from text-verbatim DIRECT facts; not automatic EXACT closure
historyDeletion: confirmed transactional deletion of selected research session, answers, evidence and images; active sessions protected; indexed corpus and original Zotero items/files untouched
answerReadiness: per-question supported conclusions are distinct from global workflow completion; deterministic finalization before and after writing; reviewed source-support candidates are prioritized for explicit FactRecord registration; remaining-action navigation after research tool batches
requestLifecycle: OpenAI-compatible SSE with terminal validation, text-block and complete-message compatibility; reasoning-only complete stop gets one same-budget continuation, not replay; blank, unsupported and refused responses classified separately with sanitized diagnostics; 32 MiB request and 128 MiB response UTF-8 guards, 16 Mi character SSE frame guard; no implicit HTTP retries; audit renderer failure does not block answer persistence
